import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Fix species label variants
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Adeile': 'Adelie', 'Gentto': 'Gentoo'})
    # Fix island case variant
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.title()
    # Parse body_mass_g written as text (e.g. '3,800')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    # Enforce valid range 2500-6500 g; treat out-of-range as missing
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = float('nan')
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    s = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean().dropna()
    return {k: round(float(v), 2) for k, v in s.items()}
